decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the cycle storage enclosure to provide covered, accessible and secure storage, in the locations approved under plan reference ; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06000 has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed, and the storage provision shall be in place prior to the first occupation of the development, and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval prior to the proposed meanwhile uses coming into first occupation. The development shall only be completed and operated in accordance with any approval.<br></p><p><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt"><span lang="EN-US" style="">As per the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the
specifications of: “Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable
Dwellings” of The&nbsp;Building Regulations 2015 and thereafter retained in
that form as far as possible.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the private outdoor amenity space (and associated boundary fencing), as shown under approved plan reference 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06000, has been provided. The development shall operate in accordance with these approved details thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt"><br></p>
<p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Fire Safety (Reasonable Exemption Statement) Document (dated 27.07.24) by D Patel Architects Ltd.</p>
The areas of flat roof hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>The development shall not progress beyond damp proof course until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works site. Details shall include (a) planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities. (b) the ground surfacing (including grasscrete specification&nbsp; and hardstanding for the site) and (c) the boundary treatment and other fencing on site</p>

The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree on or bordering the site&nbsp;shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition, and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved documents, the development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until revised details active and passive electric vehicle charging points have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority in accordance with London Plan standards. The arrangements so agreed shall be put in place prior to the first occupation of the units hereby approved and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of bin storage / recycling storage enclosures in relation to the storage approved under plan reference ; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06000, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed, and the storage provision shall be in place prior to the first occupation of the development, and retained thereafter. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the thereby approved designated refuse storage area</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the private outdoor amenity space (and associated boundary fencing), as shown under approved plan reference 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06000, has been provided. The development shall operate in accordance with these approved details thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The development shall not progress beyond damp proof course until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape for the&nbsp; site. Details shall include (a) planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities. (b) the ground surfacing (including grasscrete specification&nbsp; and proposed hardstanding, including confirmation of its permeability for sections to front of development); and (c) the boundary treatment and other fencing on site</p>

<p>The development of any buildings hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of surface and foul water, including the incorporation of sustainable drainage features as appropriate, have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The works shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>The development shall not progress beyond damp proof course until details of the provision of green/biodiverse roofs within the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details to be submitted shall comprise:</p><p>a) identification of the roof areas to be used for the provision of green/biodiverse roofs;</p><p>b) details of the planting and substrate to be used, including roof build up, plant species/mix(es) schedule which should include at least 20 native flower species, plans and sections as appropriate; and</p><p>c) details of the maintenance including irrigation.</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained and maintained as such thereafter.</p>

<p>The development shall not be occupied until an external lighting plan is, submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, to ensure that there will be no adverse impact on the behaviour of wildlife residing or foraging within or along the margin of the adjacent SINC and minimising the use of night time lighting and lighting scatter through appropriate design, control and lighting unit choice.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, D and E in Part 2 of Schedule 2 to that Order (or subsequent equivalent development in any amended permitted development framework) shall be carried out without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.</p>

<p>No occupation shall take place of the approved dwellings until the habitat creation and enhancement works set out in the approved Biodiversity Plan, Metric and Biodiversity Netgain Areas drawing have been completed; including the recommended bat and bird boxes and hedgehog friendly fencing; and a completion report, evidencing the completed habitat enhancements, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The created and/or enhanced habitat specified in the above shall be managed and maintained in accordance with approved documents thereafter.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_01000 – Site and Location Plans; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_01500 – Existing and Proposed Site Plans; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06000 – Proposed Ground Floor Plan;&nbsp; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06001 – Proposed First Floor Plan;&nbsp; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06002 – Proposed Second Floor Loft Plan; 2015_DPA_ZZ_00_DR_A_06000 – Proposed Roof Plan; 2015_DPA_ZZ_XX_DR_A_06200 – Existing and Proposed Site Elevations; 2015_DPA_ZZ_XX_DR_A_06201 Proposed Section; 2015_DPA_ZZ_XX_DR_A_06500 Biodiversity Netgain Areas; Energy and Environment Statement by D Patel Architects (dated 26.07.24); Transport Statement by Civic Engineers (dated 09 July 2024); Biodiversity Plan by Ecology Link; Statutory Biodiversity Metric; Arboricultural Survey Report and Impact Assessment by Ecology Link (dated June 2024); Arboricultural Method Statement by Ecology Link (6th November 2023); Ecology Report - Extended Phase 1 Habitat Survey Report by Ecology Links (dated June 2023); Design, Access and Planning Statement (dated 26.07.24) by D Patel Architects; Daylight and Sunlight Study by D Patel Architects (dated 19.07.24); Fire Safety (Reasonable Exemption Statement) Document</p><p>All documents received 31.07.24</p>

<div><div>No development shall take place until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – www.tfl.gov.uk. The Construction Method Statement shall provide for:</div><div><br></div><div>a) Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors.</div><div><br></div><div>b) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials.</div><div><br></div><div>c) Number of HGV’s anticipated.</div><div><br></div><div>d) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development.</div><div><br></div><div>e) Programme of work and phasing.</div><div><br></div><div>f) Site layout plan. g) Measures to control dust and dirt during construction.</div><div><br></div><div>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</div><div><br></div></div><div><br></div>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the southwest flank elevation at first floor level or roof lights within the associated south-west roofslope of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>
description: Construction of two double storey semi detached dwellinghouses (2 x 3 beds); parking; separate amenity space; landscaping; green roof; bin / cycle storage; boundary treatment (Amended description)
subdivision_of_building: not applicable as there are no existing buildings on site
